resources.string: No alerts yet. New ETS alerts will appear here.
Could not reach the ETS server. Check that the VPN is connected.
No browser is installed to open this alert.
Urgent ETS alerts. Sound and heads-up.
Shown while the persistent connection is on.
This phone was removed from ETS. Pair again from Profile → My devices.
In ETS on the web, open Profile → My devices (أجهزتي) and create a pairing QR code. Then scan it here.
Point the camera at the ETS pairing QR code
The phone must be connected to the company VPN to reach the ETS server.
Keeps a live connection for instant alerts and shows a small permanent notification. When off, the app checks for alerts about every 15 minutes.
For reliable delivery, set ETS Alerts to “Not optimised” / “Unrestricted”.
Battery settings are not available on this device.
This removes the pairing from this phone. Please also remove the device on the web under Profile → My devices.
Scan the QR code or paste the pairing code first.
This is not an ETS pairing code. Paste the full JSON shown under the QR code.
This pairing code needs a newer version of the app.
The server address in the code is invalid. Only https:// addresses are allowed.
The pairing code is missing or invalid.
The certificate fingerprint in the code is invalid.
The server rejected the pairing code. It may have expired; create a new QR code and try again.
Secure connection failed: the server certificate does not match the pairing code.
Could not reach the server. Make sure the VPN is connected and try again.
Something went wrong. Please try again.
